section.content: The machine learning device according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes: a road surface detection processing unit that detects a road surface included in the first captured image, based on the first captured image and a first distance image corresponding to the first captured image; a distance value selecting unit that selects one or more distance values to be processed from among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image, based on a processing result of the road surface detection processing unit; and a learning processing unit that performs machine learning processing based on the first captured image and one or more distance values, thereby generating a learning model in which the second captured image is input and the second distance image corresponding to the second captured image is output.

本公开的一个实施方式的机器学习装置具备：路面检测处理部，其基于第一拍摄图像以及与第一拍摄图像对应的第一距离图像，检测第一拍摄图像中所包含的路面；距离值选择部，其基于路面检测处理部的处理结果，选择第一距离图像中所包含的多个距离值中的、成为处理对象的一个以上的距离值；以及学习处理部，其基于第一拍摄图像和一个以上的距离值进行机器学习处理，由此生成被输入第二拍摄图像并输出与第二拍摄图像对应的第二距离图像的学习模型。

Machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning apparatus that performs learning processing based on a captured image and a distance image.

Background

In the case of a vehicle, an environment outside the vehicle is often detected, and control of the vehicle is performed based on the detection result thereof. Regarding the recognition of the environment outside the vehicle, the distance from the vehicle to the surrounding solid object is often detected. Patent document 1 discloses a technique for performing arithmetic processing of a neural network based on a captured image and a distance image.

Prior art literature

Patent literature

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2018-147286

Disclosure of Invention

In addition, there is a learning model that generates a distance image based on a captured image. The generated range image is expected to have high accuracy, and further improvement in accuracy is expected.

It is desirable to provide a machine learning device capable of generating a learning model capable of generating a distance image with high accuracy.

The machine learning device according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes a road surface detection processing unit, a distance value selection unit, and a learning processing unit. The road surface detection processing unit is configured to detect a road surface included in the first captured image based on the first captured image and a first distance image corresponding to the first captured image. The distance value selecting unit is configured to select one or more distance values to be processed from among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image, based on a processing result of the road surface detection processing unit. The learning processing unit is configured to perform machine learning processing based on the first captured image and one or more distance values, thereby generating a learning model to which the second captured image is input and outputting a second distance image corresponding to the second captured image.

According to the machine learning device of one embodiment of the present disclosure, a learning model capable of generating a distance image with high accuracy can be generated.

Detailed Description

Embodiments of the present disclosure will be described in detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings.

< embodiment >

Construction example

Fig. 1 is a diagram showing one configuration example of an in-vehicle environment recognition system 10 that performs processing using a learning model generated by a machine learning device (machine learning device 20) according to one embodiment. The vehicle exterior environment recognition system 10 is mounted on a vehicle 100 such as an automobile. The vehicle exterior environment recognition system 10 includes a stereo camera 11 and a processing unit 12.

The stereo camera 11 is configured to generate a set of images (left image PL1 and right image PR 1) having parallax with each other by photographing the front of the vehicle 100. The stereo camera 11 has a left camera 11L and a right camera 11R. The left camera 11L and the right camera 11R include a lens and an image sensor, respectively. In this example, the left camera 11L and the right camera 11R are disposed in the vehicle of the vehicle 100 near the upper portion of the front glass of the vehicle 100, separated by a predetermined distance in the width direction of the vehicle 100. The left camera 11L generates a left image PL1, and the right camera 11R generates a right image PR1. The left image PL1 and the right image PR1 constitute a stereoscopic image PIC1. The stereo camera 11 generates a series of stereo images PIC1 by performing shooting operation at a predetermined frame rate (for example, 60[ fps ]), and supplies the generated stereo images PIC1 to the processing section 12.

The processing unit 12 is configured by, for example, one or more processors executing programs, one or more RAMs (Random Access Memory: random access memories) temporarily storing processing data, one or more ROMs (Read Only memories) storing programs, and the like. The processing unit 12 includes a distance image generating unit 13, a distance image generating unit 14, and an outside-vehicle environment recognizing unit 15.

The distance image generating unit 13 is configured to perform predetermined image processing including stereo matching processing, filtering processing, and the like based on the left image PL1 and the right image PR1, thereby generating a distance image PZ13. Specifically, the distance image generating unit 13 determines corresponding points including two image points (left image point and right image point) corresponding to each other based on the left image PL1 and the right image PR 1. The left image point contains, for example, 16 pixels in the left image PL1 arranged, for example, in 4 rows and 4 columns, and the right image point contains, for example, 16 pixels in the right image PR1 arranged, for example, in 4 rows and 4 columns. The difference between the abscissa value of the left image point in the left image PL1 and the abscissa value of the right image point in the right image PR1 corresponds to the distance value in the three-dimensional real space. The distance image generation unit 13 generates a distance image PZ13 based on the determined plurality of corresponding points. The distance image PZ13 includes a plurality of distance values. Each of the plurality of distance values may be an actual distance value in the three-dimensional actual space or a disparity value which is a difference between an abscissa value of the left image point in the left image PL1 and an abscissa value of the right image point in the right image PR 1.

In this example, the distance image generating unit 14 is configured to generate the distance image PZ14 using the learning model M based on a captured image that is one of the left image PL1 and the right image PR 1. The learning model M is a model of a neural network that is input with a captured image and outputs a distance image PZ14. The learning model M is previously generated by the machine learning device 20 described later, and stored in the range image generation unit 14 of the vehicle 100. The distance image PZ14 includes a plurality of distance values similarly to the distance image PZ 13.

The vehicle exterior environment recognition unit 15 is configured to recognize the vehicle exterior environment of the vehicle 100 based on the left image PL1, the right image PR1, and the distance images PZ13, PZ14. In the vehicle 100, for example, it is possible to perform traveling control of the vehicle 100 based on information on a three-dimensional object outside the vehicle recognized by the vehicle outside environment recognition unit 15, or to display information on the recognized three-dimensional object on a console monitor.

Fig. 2 is a diagram showing an example of the structure of the machine learning device 20 for generating the learning model M. The machine learning device 20 is, for example, a server device. The machine learning device 20 includes a storage unit 21 and a processing unit 22.

The storage unit 21 is a nonvolatile storage device such as an HDD (Hard Disk Drive) and an SSD (Solid State Drive) and the like. The storage unit 21 stores image data DT and a learning model M.

The image data DT is image data of a plurality of stereoscopic images PIC 2. As with the stereoscopic image PIC1 shown in fig. 1, each of the plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 is generated by a stereoscopic camera and stored in the storage unit 21. As with the stereoscopic image PIC1 shown in fig. 1, each of the plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 includes a left image PL2 and a right image PR2.

The learning model M is a model used in the range image generation unit 14 (fig. 1) of the vehicle 100. The learning model M is generated by the processing unit 22 and stored in the storage unit 21. The learning model M stored in the storage unit 21 is set in the range image generation unit 14 of the vehicle 100.

The processing section 22 is constituted by, for example, one or more processors executing programs, one or more RAMs temporarily storing processing data, and the like. The processing unit 22 includes an image data acquisition unit 23, a distance image generation unit 24, and an image processing unit 25.

The image data acquisition unit 23 is configured to acquire a plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 from the storage unit 21, and sequentially supply the left image PL2 and the right image PR2 included in each of the plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 to the distance image generation unit 24.

As with the distance image generating unit 13 (fig. 1) in the vehicle 100, the distance image generating unit 24 is configured to generate the distance image PZ24 by performing predetermined image processing including stereo matching processing, filtering processing, and the like based on the left image PL2 and the right image PR2.

The image processing unit 25 is configured to perform predetermined image processing based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ24, thereby generating the learning model M. The image processing unit 25 includes an image edge detection unit 31, a grouping processing unit 32, a road surface detection processing unit 33, a three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34, a distance value selection unit 35, an image selection unit 36, and a learning processing unit 37.

The image edge detection section 31 is configured to detect an image portion having strong edge intensity in the left image PL2 and to detect an image portion having strong edge intensity in the right image PR 2. The image edge detection unit 31 determines a distance value included in the distance image PZ24 and obtained based on the detected image portion. That is, since the distance image generating unit 24 performs the stereo matching process based on the left image PL2 and the right image PR2, it is expected that the accuracy of the distance value obtained based on the image portion having strong edge intensity in the left image PL2 and the right image PR2 is high. Therefore, the image edge detection unit 31 determines a plurality of distance values with high accuracy, which are expected to be included in the distance image PZ 24. Then, the image edge detection unit 31 generates a distance image PZ31 including the determined plurality of distance values.

The grouping processing unit 32 is configured to group a plurality of points in the three-dimensional space that are close to each other into a group based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ31, thereby generating the distance image PZ32. That is, when the stereo matching process is performed by the distance image generating unit 24, there is a case where an erroneous corresponding point is determined by mismatch (mismatch) from the image. For example, the distance value involved in the mismatch in the distance image PZ31 may deviate from the distance value around it. The packet processing unit 32 can remove the distance value related to such mismatching to a certain extent by performing the packet processing.

The road surface detection processing unit 33 is configured to detect a road surface based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ32.

Fig. 3 to 5 are diagrams showing an example of the operation of the road surface detection processing unit 33. As shown in fig. 3, the road surface detection processing unit 33 first sets the operation target area RA based on, for example, one of the left image PL2 and the right image PR 2. In this example, the operation target area RA is a divided vehicleThe area sandwiched by the two dividing lines 90L, 90R of the track. Then, as shown in fig. 3, the road surface detection processing unit 33 sequentially selects horizontal lines HL in the distance image PZ32, and generates a histogram concerning the distances based on the distance values of the operation object region RA in the regions on the respective horizontal lines HL. Histogram H shown in FIG. 4 j Is the j-th horizontal line HL from the bottom j The histogram involved. The horizontal axis represents the value of the coordinate z in the vehicle longitudinal direction of the vehicle, and the vertical axis represents the frequency. In this example, at the coordinate value z j Where the frequency is highest. The road surface detection processing unit 33 obtains the coordinate value z with the highest frequency j As the j-th horizontal line HL j And represents the distance. The road surface detection processing section 33 obtains the representative distances on the plurality of horizontal lines HL in this way. Then, the road surface detection processing unit 33 draws these representative distances as distance points D in the z-j plane, as shown in fig. 5. In this example, a horizontal line HL representing the 0 th horizontal line is drawn on the z-j plane 0 Distance point D representing distance 0 (z 0 0), representing a first horizontal line HL 1 Distance point D representing distance 1 (z 1 1) represents a second horizontal line HL 2 Distance point D representing distance 2 (z 2 2) a plurality of distance points D. In this example, the distance points D are arranged on a substantially straight line. The road surface detection processing unit 33 performs fitting processing based on these distance points D, for example, to thereby obtain a function representing the road surface. In this way, the road surface detection processing unit 33 detects the road surface.

The road surface detection processing unit 33 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection processing, among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, to the distance value selecting unit 35. That is, the road surface detection processing unit 33 detects the road surface based on the representative distances of the plurality of horizontal lines HL, as described above. Therefore, in each of the plurality of horizontal lines HL, a plurality of distance values constituting the representative distance are employed in the road surface detection process, and a plurality of distance values not constituting the representative distance are not employed in the road surface detection process. The road surface detection processing unit 33 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection processing to the distance value selecting unit 35.

The solid object detection processing unit 34 is configured to detect a solid object based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ 32. The standing object detection processing unit 34 detects a standing object by grouping a plurality of points in the three-dimensional space that are close to each other in a position above the road surface obtained by the road surface detection processing unit 33. Specifically, the three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34 can detect a three-dimensional object by grouping a plurality of points having a distance of, for example, 0.1m or less in a three-dimensional space.

The three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection processing, out of a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, to the distance value selection unit 35. As described above, the three-dimensional object detection processing section 34 detects a three-dimensional object by grouping a plurality of points in the three-dimensional space that are close to each other at positions above the road surface. Therefore, the desired distance value near the solid object is used in the solid object detection process, and for example, as described later, the distance value related to mismatching near the solid object and the distance value related to specular reflection when the road surface is wet are not used in the solid object detection process. The three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection processing to the distance value selection unit 35.

The distance value selecting unit 35 is configured to select a plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37 from among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32 supplied from the grouping processing unit 32. The distance value selecting unit 35 can select, for example, a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection process among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, as the plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37. The distance value selecting unit 35 may select, for example, a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, as the plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37. The distance value selecting unit 35 can select, for example, a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process and the road surface detection process among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, as the plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37. The distance value selecting unit 35 supplies the distance image PZ35 including the selected plurality of distance values to the learning processing unit 37.

The image selecting unit 36 is configured to supply the captured image P2, which is one of the left image PL2 and the right image PR2, to the learning processing unit 37. The image selecting section 36 can select, for example, a clear image among the left image PL2 and the right image PR2 as the captured image P2.

The learning processing unit 37 is configured to perform machine learning processing using a neural network based on the captured image P2 and the distance image PZ35, thereby generating a learning model M. In the learning processing section 37, the captured image P2 is supplied, and the distance image PZ35 is supplied as an expected value. The learning processing unit 37 performs machine learning processing based on these images, thereby generating a learning model M in which a captured image is input and a distance image is output.

Fig. 6 is a diagram showing one configuration example of the neural network. In this example, a photographed image is input from the left side of fig. 6, and a distance image is output from the right side of fig. 6. In this neural network, for example, compression processing A1 is performed based on a captured image, and convolution processing A2 is performed based on compressed data. In the neural network, the compression process A1 and the convolution process A2 are repeated a plurality of times. Then, the up-sampling process B1 is performed based on the generated data, and the convolution process B2 is performed based on the data obtained by performing the up-sampling process B1. In the neural network, the up-sampling process B1 and the convolution process B2 are repeated a plurality of times. In the convolution processing A2, B2, a filter of a predetermined size (for example, 3 pixels×3 pixels) is used.

The learning processing section 37 inputs the photographed image P2 to the neural network, and calculates differences between a plurality of distance values in the output distance image and a plurality of distance values in the distance image PZ35 as expected values, respectively. Then, the learning processing section 37 adjusts the values of the filters used in the convolution processes A2, B2, for example, so that these differences become sufficiently small. The learning processing section 37 performs machine learning processing in this way.

The learning processing unit 37 can set whether or not to perform learning processing for each image region, for example. Specifically, the learning processing section 37 can perform the machine learning processing on the image area to which the distance value is supplied from the distance value selecting section 35, and can not perform the machine learning processing on the image area to which the distance value is not supplied from the distance value selecting section 35. For example, the learning processing section 37 can forcibly set the difference between the distance values in the image area to which the distance value is not supplied from the distance value selecting section 35 to "0" so that the machine learning process is not performed on the image area.

For example, in the neural network shown in fig. 6, a learning model having a global field of view can be obtained when the number of layers is larger. By performing the machine learning process by inputting a blurred captured image to such a neural network, for example, a learning model M that can obtain more distance values can be generated based on a captured image with less texture.

Here, the road surface detection processing unit 33 corresponds to one specific example of the "road surface detection processing unit" in the present disclosure. The three-dimensional object detection processing section 34 corresponds to one specific example of the "three-dimensional object detection processing section" in the present disclosure. The distance value selecting section 35 corresponds to one specific example of the "distance value selecting section" in the present disclosure. The learning processing section 37 corresponds to one specific example of the "learning processing section" in the present disclosure. The stereoscopic image PIC2 corresponds to one specific example of the "first captured image" in the present disclosure. The distance image PZ35 corresponds to one specific example of the "first distance image" in the present disclosure.

[ action and action ]

Next, the operation and operation of the machine learning device 20 and the vehicle exterior environment recognition system 10 according to the present embodiment will be described.

(general action outline)

First, the operation of the machine learning device 20 will be described with reference to fig. 2. The machine learning device 20 stores image data DT including a plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 generated by, for example, a stereoscopic camera in the storage unit 21. The image data acquisition unit 23 of the processing unit 22 acquires the plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 from the storage unit 21, and sequentially supplies the left image PL2 and the right image PR2 included in each of the plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 to the distance image generation unit 24. The distance image generation unit 24 performs predetermined image processing including stereo matching processing, filtering processing, and the like based on the left image PL2 and the right image PR2, thereby generating a distance image PZ24. The image edge detection section 31 of the image processing section 25 detects an image portion with strong edge intensity in the left image PL2, and detects an image portion with strong edge intensity in the right image PR 2. Then, the image edge detection unit 31 determines a distance value obtained based on the detected image portion included in the distance image PZ24, and generates a distance image PZ31 including the determined plurality of distance values. The grouping processing section 32 groups points in the three-dimensional space that are close to each other into a group based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ31, thereby generating the distance image PZ32. The road surface detection processing unit 33 detects a road surface based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ32. The road surface detection processing unit 33 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection processing, among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, to the distance value selecting unit 35. The solid object detection processing unit 34 detects a solid object based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ32. The three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection processing, out of a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, to the distance value selection unit 35. The distance value selecting unit 35 selects a plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37 from among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32 supplied from the grouping processing unit 32. The image selecting section 36 supplies the captured image P2, which is one of the left image PL2 and the right image PR2, to the learning processing section 37. The learning processing unit 37 performs machine learning processing using a neural network based on the captured image P2 and the distance image PZ35, thereby generating a learning model M. Then, the processing unit 22 stores the learning model M in the storage unit 21. The learning model M thus generated is set in the range image generation unit 14 of the vehicle exterior environment recognition system 10.

Next, the operation of the vehicle exterior environment recognition system 10 will be described with reference to fig. 1. The stereo camera 11 generates a left image PL1 and a right image PR1 having parallax with each other by photographing the front of the vehicle 100. The distance image generating section 13 of the processing section 12 performs predetermined image processing including stereo matching processing, filtering processing, and the like based on the left image PL1 and the right image PR1, thereby generating a distance image PZ13. The distance image generation unit 14 generates a distance image PZ14 based on the captured image, which is one of the left image PL1 and the right image PR1 in this example, using the learning model M generated by the machine learning device 20. The vehicle exterior environment recognition unit 15 recognizes the vehicle exterior environment of the vehicle 100 based on the left image PL1, the right image PR1, and the distance images PZ13, PZ14.

(detailed action)

Next, the operation of the image processing unit 25 (fig. 2) in the machine learning device 20 will be described in detail.

First, the image edge detection section 31 detects an image portion of the left image PL2 having strong edge intensity, and detects an image portion of the right image PR2 having strong edge intensity. Then, the image edge detection unit 31 determines a distance value based on the detected image portion included in the distance image PZ 24. That is, since the distance image generating unit 24 performs the stereo matching process based on the left image PL2 and the right image PR2, it is expected that the accuracy of the distance value obtained based on the image portion having strong edge intensity in the left image PL2 and the right image PR2 is high. Therefore, the image edge detection unit 31 determines a plurality of distance values with high accuracy, which are expected to be included in the distance image PZ 24. Then, the image edge detection unit 31 generates a distance image PZ31 including the determined plurality of distance values.

Fig. 7 is a diagram illustrating an example of the distance image PZ 31. In this fig. 7, hatching indicates portions having distance values. The shade of the shade represents the density of the distance values. That is, the density of the obtained distance values is low in the light-shaded portion, and the density of the obtained distance values is high in the dark-shaded portion. For example, on a road surface, there is little texture, and it is difficult to detect a corresponding point in stereo matching, so the density of distance values is low. On the other hand, for example, in the case of a three-dimensional object such as a dividing line on a road surface or a vehicle, the density of distance values is high because the corresponding points are easily detected in the three-dimensional matching.

Next, the grouping processing section 32 groups a plurality of points in the three-dimensional space that are close to each other into a group based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ31, thereby generating the distance image PZ32.

Fig. 8 is a diagram illustrating an example of the distance image PZ32. In the distance image PZ32, for example, the distance value is removed at a portion where the density of the obtained distance value is lower than that of the distance image PZ31 shown in fig. 7. When the stereo matching process is performed by the distance image generating unit 24, there is a possibility that an erroneous corresponding point is specified due to erroneous matching from the image. For example, in a portion with a small texture like a road surface, there are few corresponding points, and there are many corresponding points related to such mismatching. The distance values involved in the mismatch may deviate from the distance values around them. The packet processing unit 32 can remove the distance value related to such mismatching to a certain extent by performing the packet processing.

In fig. 8, for example, the road surface is wet with rain, and specular reflection by the road surface occurs. The portion W1 represents an image of the tail lamp of the preceding vehicle 9 reflected by the road surface. The distance value in the portion W1 can correspond to the distance from the host vehicle to the preceding vehicle 9. However, the image itself is generated on the road surface. Such a virtual image may be included in the distance image PZ 32.

Next, the road surface detection processing section 33 detects the road surface based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ 32. The road surface detection processing unit 33 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection processing, among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, to the distance value selecting unit 35.

Fig. 9 is a diagram showing a distance image representing a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection process, among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ 32. As shown in fig. 9, a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection process are located at portions corresponding to the road surface. That is, these plurality of distance values each represent a distance from the host vehicle to the road surface.

In this distance image, as shown by a portion W2, a distance value caused by a virtual image of specular reflection is removed. That is, as described above, the distance value at the portion W1 of fig. 8 may correspond to the distance from the host vehicle to the preceding vehicle 9. However, in the histogram associated with each of the plurality of horizontal lines HL in the road surface detection process, the frequency of the distance value is low, and therefore, the distance value is difficult to become a representative distance. As a result, the distance value is not used in the road surface detection process, and is therefore removed from the distance image shown in fig. 9.

As described above, in the distance image (fig. 9) showing a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection process, noise of the distance values is reduced as compared with the distance image PZ32 shown in fig. 8.

Next, the solid object detection processing section 34 detects a solid object based on the left image PL2, the right image PR2, and the distance image PZ 32. The three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34 supplies information on a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection processing, out of a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, to the distance value selection unit 35.

Fig. 10 is a diagram showing a range image indicating a plurality of range values used in the three-dimensional object detection process, among a plurality of range values included in the range image PZ 32. As shown in fig. 10, a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process are located at the portions corresponding to the three-dimensional objects. That is, the plurality of distance values each represent a distance from the host vehicle to the three-dimensional object located above the road surface.

The solid object detection processing unit 34 detects a solid object by grouping a plurality of points in the three-dimensional space that are close to each other at positions above the road surface. The distance values involved in a mismatch near the solid object may deviate from the distance values around it. Therefore, the three-dimensional object detection processing unit 34 can remove the distance value related to the mismatching at the side surface, the wall, or the like of the vehicle.

In this distance image, as shown by a portion W3, a distance value caused by the virtual image of specular reflection is removed. That is, as described above, the distance value at the portion W1 of fig. 8 may correspond to the distance from the host vehicle to the preceding vehicle 9. However, the image itself is generated on the road surface. Therefore, the position in the three-dimensional space obtained based on the image is under the road surface. The solid object detection processing unit 34 detects a solid object based on an image above the road surface. As a result, the distance value is not used in the three-dimensional object detection process, and is therefore removed from the distance image shown in fig. 10.

As described above, in the distance image (fig. 10) showing a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process, noise of the distance values is reduced as compared with the distance image PZ32 shown in fig. 8.

The distance value selecting unit 35 selects a plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37 from among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32 supplied from the grouping processing unit 32. The distance value selecting unit 35 can select, for example, a plurality of distance values used in the road surface detection process among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, as the plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37. The distance value selecting unit 35 can select, for example, a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, as the plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37. The distance value selecting unit 35 can select, for example, a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process and the road surface detection process among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ32, as the plurality of distance values supplied to the learning processing unit 37. The distance value selecting unit 35 supplies the distance image PZ35 including the selected plurality of distance values to the learning processing unit 37. In this way, the distance image PZ35 in which the noise of the distance value is reduced is supplied to the learning processing section 37.

The image selecting section 36 supplies the captured image P2, which is one of the left image PL2 and the right image PR2, to the learning processing section 37. Then, the learning processing unit 37 performs machine learning processing using a neural network based on the captured image P2 and the distance image PZ35, thereby generating a learning model M. In the learning processing section 37, the captured image P2 is supplied, and the distance image PZ35 is supplied as an expected value. Since the distance image PZ35 in which the noise of the distance value is reduced is supplied to the learning processing section 37, the learning model M with good accuracy can be generated.

Next, the distance image PZ14 generated by the distance image generating unit 14 of the vehicle exterior environment recognition system 10 using the learning model M thus generated will be described.

Fig. 11 is a diagram showing an example of a captured image generated by the stereo camera 11 in the in-vehicle environment recognition system 10. In fig. 11, for example, the road surface is wet with rain, and specular reflection by the road surface occurs. The portion W4 represents an image of the pole reflected by the road surface.

Fig. 12 and 13 are diagrams showing an example of the distance image PZ14 generated by the distance image generating unit 14 using the learning model M based on the captured image shown in fig. 11. Fig. 12 shows a case where the machine learning device 20 generates the learning model M based on all of the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ 32. Fig. 13 shows a case where the machine learning device 20 generates the learning model M based on a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process and the road surface detection process, among a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ 32. In fig. 12 and 13, the shading of the hatching indicates the distance value. The light shading indicates that the distance value is small, and the dark shading indicates that the distance value is large.

In the example of fig. 12, as shown in a portion W5, the distance values are disordered due to the influence of the virtual image caused by the specular reflection. Although the distance to the road surface where the utility pole is shown is short, the actual distance to the utility pole is long, and thus the distance value at the portion W5 is large as shown in fig. 12. In this way, the distance image generating unit 14 directly outputs the distance value based on the inputted captured image.

In the example of fig. 12, the machine learning device 20 generates the learning model M based on all of the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ 32. That is, the learning model M learns using, for example, a captured image including an image portion of specular reflection and a distance image (for example, fig. 8) including a distance value of an error caused by specular reflection. Therefore, as shown in fig. 11, when the input captured image includes a specularly reflected image portion as in the portion W4, the distance image generating unit 14 outputs a distance value corresponding to the image portion as shown in fig. 12.

On the other hand, in the example of fig. 13, the distance values are not staggered as shown in fig. 12. In the example of fig. 13, the machine learning device 20 generates the learning model M based on a plurality of distance values used in the three-dimensional object detection process and the road surface detection process, out of a plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ 32. That is, the learning model M learns using, for example, an image including specular reflection and a distance image (for example, fig. 9 and 10) that does not include a distance value of an error caused by specular reflection. That is, an erroneous distance value caused by specular reflection is not used in the machine learning process. The machine learning process is performed using the stereoscopic image PIC2 in various conditions such as various weather conditions, various time periods, and the like. These plurality of stereoscopic images PIC2 also include images that do not cause specular reflection, for example. Therefore, even in the case where the input captured image (fig. 11) includes the image portion of specular reflection as in the portion W4, the distance image generation section 14 can reflect learning under such various conditions, and output the distance value in the case where there is no specular reflection as shown in fig. 13.

As described above, the machine learning device 20 includes: a road surface detection processing unit 33 that detects a road surface included in the first captured image (stereoscopic image PIC 2) based on the first captured image (stereoscopic image PIC 2) and a first distance image (distance image PZ 32) corresponding to the first captured image (stereoscopic image PIC 2); a distance value selecting unit 35 that selects one or more distance values to be processed from among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image (distance image PZ 32) based on the processing result of the road surface detection processing unit 33; and a learning processing unit 37 that performs machine learning processing based on the first captured image (stereoscopic image PIC 2) and one or more distance values, thereby generating a learning model M in which a second captured image is input and a second distance image corresponding to the second captured image is output. Thus, the machine learning device 20 can perform the machine learning process based on one or more distance values selected based on the processing result of the road surface detection processing unit 33 from among the plurality of distance values included in the distance image PZ 32. The distance value selecting unit 35 can select, for example, a distance value (fig. 9) used in the road surface detection process as one or more distance values, and can select a distance value (fig. 10) used in the three-dimensional object detection process of detecting a three-dimensional object on a road surface as one or more distance values. As a result, the machine learning device 20 can generate the learning model M, which can generate a distance image with high accuracy.

In generating such a learning model M, machine learning may be performed using, for example, a range image obtained by a laser radar (Light detection and ranging: light detection and ranging) device and a captured image. However, since the characteristics of the image sensor that generates the captured image and the characteristics of the lidar device that generates the range image are different from each other, for example, although not shown in the captured image, there is a possibility that a range value may be obtained in the range image. In the case where such a contradiction occurs, it is difficult to perform the machine learning process.

On the other hand, in the example shown in fig. 2, since the machine learning device 20 generates the distance images PZ24, PZ31, and PZ32 based on the stereoscopic image PIC2, the above-described contradiction is difficult to occur, and therefore the machine learning process can be easily performed. As a result, the machine learning device 20 can improve the accuracy of the learning model.

In addition, even when the machine learning process is performed using the distance image PZ24 generated based on the stereoscopic image PIC2 generated by the stereoscopic camera, as described above, a false image such as mismatching or specular reflection occurs, and thus the distance image PZ24 may contain an inaccurate distance value. Therefore, it is difficult to improve the accuracy of the learning model. Further, although it is considered to screen accurate distance values and inaccurate distance values from the distance image PZ24, it is not realistic for a person to perform these screens, for example.

On the other hand, in the machine learning device 20, one or more distance values to be processed among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image (distance image PZ 32) are selected based on the processing result of the road surface detection processing unit 33, and the machine learning process is performed based on the first captured image (stereo image PIC 2) and the one or more distance values. Thus, the machine learning device 20 can reduce the influence of mismatching, specular reflection, and the like, and can screen accurate distance values without requiring human annotation work. As a result, the machine learning device 20 can improve the accuracy of the learning model.

In the example shown in fig. 2, the machine learning device 20 generates distance images PZ24, PZ31, PZ32 by stereo matching. In this way, when stereo matching is performed, a distance value with high accuracy can be obtained. However, since the matching is locally generated, the density of the distance values may be low. Even in such a case, by using the learning model M generated by the machine learning device 20, a distance value with high density can be obtained with high accuracy in the entire region.

In the machine learning device 20, the learning processing unit 37 performs machine learning processing on an image region corresponding to one or more distances among the entire image region of the first captured image (stereoscopic image PIC 2) based on one or more distance values. Thus, the learning processing unit 37 can perform the machine learning processing on the image area to which the distance value is supplied from the distance value selecting unit 35, and can not perform the machine learning processing on the image area to which the distance value is not supplied from the distance value selecting unit 35. As a result, for example, since the machine learning process can be performed without based on the erroneous distance value due to the specular reflection, the accuracy of the learning model can be improved.

[ Effect ]

As described above, in the present embodiment, there is provided: a road surface detection processing unit that detects a road surface included in the first captured image from the first captured image and a first distance image corresponding to the first captured image; a distance value selecting unit that selects one or more distance values to be processed from among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image, based on a processing result of the road surface detection processing unit; and a learning processing unit that performs machine learning processing based on the first captured image and one or more distance values, thereby generating a learning model that is input with the second captured image and outputs a second distance image corresponding to the second captured image.

In the present embodiment, since the machine learning process is performed on the image area corresponding to one or more distances out of the entire image area of the first captured image based on one or more distance values, the accuracy of the learning model can be improved.
